ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted theorem prover and pattern recognition engine tailored specifically for Olympiad-style non-routine mathematics problems.
ideas.title: NonRoutineProofSearch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the core theme of the Math-O-Stellar competition, targeting logical reasoning and flexible thinking rather than standard routine curriculum.

ideas.pitch: An interactive canvas that helps students visualize recursive sequences, number theory invariants, and geometric transformations to spot hidden patterns quickly.
ideas.title: MathPatternExplorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aids competitors in pattern recognition and insight generation, which are heavily tested in non-routine mathematics formats.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking and hint-generation pipeline that evaluates LLM reasoning paths against multi-step mathematical proofs with confidence intervals.
ideas.title: OlympiadSolverBench
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard algorithmic engineering with mathematical rigor, appealing to judges who value technical depth over generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A graph-based intelligence tool that maps out logical dependencies and sub-goals in complex mathematical proofs.
ideas.title: ProofGraphViz
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases graph intelligence applied to logical reasoning, solving a technically difficult problem relevant to advanced problem solvers.

ideas.pitch: A real-time collaborative workspace for teams of 1-2 to solve complex math problems together with integrated LaTeX rendering and scratchpad tools.
ideas.title: MathCollabPad
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides essential tooling for the exact format of the hackathon, making it an immediately useful utility for participants.
